corrections.policy: Published numbers never change in place. A corrected number is published as a new dated run, and every correction is listed on the page.

log.what: Re-scan of the 2026-07-19 calibration run on the retuned engine. This supersedes the earlier 2026-07-19 run, whose top-1000 false-block figure was the pre-retune number as measured, published while a re-run was pending. The full 1,000-package scan was re-run on the fixed engine. The single pre-retune heuristic false block now resolves to review, and no new false block appeared, giving 0 / 1,000.
Copy edit only. No measured number, input list, or source URL changed. Reworded the notes and the earlier entries on this page for plainer language and shorter sentences.

notes: Aggregate calibration from the 2026-07-19 large static scan, re-run on the retuned engine. Catch rate is measured against the committed corpus of rebuilt known malware, because npm removes live malware and recall against the live registry cannot be tested. The top-1000 false-block figure is the count re-measured on the fixed engine. See the methodology page.
